::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2021 in Bengaluru by Sujoy Chakravarty, Ravi Mehta and Biman Chattopadhyay (ex-Texas Instruments; earlier co-founded Silabtech, sold to Synopsys in 2018), with Aditi Vaidya, Prof Anil Prabhakar (IIT Madras) and Prof Sandeep Goyal (IISER Mohali). Building room-temperature photonic quantum and Ising-machine hardware; raised $10M led by Chiratae (October 2026). Roadmap: early processors 2027, larger systems 2029.
:::

## What does this firm design?

A time-multiplexed coherent (optical) Ising machine handling up to 100,000 variables, and photonic integrated circuits for quantum computing.
